overview: This House resolution assigns two members of the House of Representatives to committees. It places Representative Walkinshaw on the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, ranked immediately after Representative Min, and Representative Frost on the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure. Committee assignments decide which members help write and review bills in each policy area. The House adopted the resolution, with the final procedural step taken on September 16, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling committee seats lets new and existing members take part fully in drafting and overseeing legislation.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine housekeeping measure with no effect on any law or spending.
